records.source: An assortment of wild fall seeds.
records.translation: Iba't ibang ligaw na binhi sa taglagas.

records.source: A stone of unknown origins. Looks like it could be placed into something.
records.translation: Batong hindi alam ang pinagmulan. Mukhang maaari itong ilagay sa isang bagay.
Hilaw na materyal na nagmumula sa mga halaman.

records.source: Plant these in any season. Does not require watering. Harvest with the scythe. Takes 7 days to grow.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa anumang panahon. Hindi kailangang diligan. Anihin gamit ang Karit. Tumatagal ng 7 araw upang lumaki.

records.source: The young shoots are an edible specialty.
records.translation: Itinuturing na espesyal na pagkain ang mga batang usbong nito.

records.englishResidueReason: Risotto is the conventional borrowed Filipino name for this specific rice dish.

records.source: A creamy rice dish served with sauteed fern heads. It's a little bland.
records.translation: Malinamnam na putaheng kanin na inihahain kasama ng ginigisang usbong ng pako. Medyo matabang ito.

records.source: A quick snack to fuel the hungry forager.
records.translation: Mabilis na meryenda upang pasiglahin ang gutom na mangangalap.

records.source: A rare variety of opal, named for its red spots.
records.translation: Bihirang uri ng opal na ipinangalan sa mga pulang batik nito.

records.source: A glowing red crystal commonly found near hot lava.
records.translation: Kumikinang na pulang kristal na karaniwang matatagpuan malapit sa mainit na lava.

records.source: An old tradition for celebrations and festivities. Handle with care!
records.translation: Matandang tradisyon para sa mga pagdiriwang at kasiyahan. Hawakan nang maingat!

records.source: An old tradition for celebrations and festivities. Handle with care!
records.translation: Matandang tradisyon para sa mga pagdiriwang at kasiyahan. Hawakan nang maingat!

records.source: An old tradition for celebrations and festivities. Handle with care!
records.translation: Matandang tradisyon para sa mga pagdiriwang at kasiyahan. Hawakan nang maingat!

records.source: It smells a lot like the sea. Tastes better, though.
records.translation: Amoy-dagat ito. Ngunit mas masarap kaysa sa amoy.

records.englishResidueReason: Taco is the conventional borrowed Filipino name for this specific dish.

records.source: It lives on the bottom, so both eyes are on top of its head.
records.translation: Naninirahan ito sa ilalim kaya nasa ibabaw ng ulo ang dalawang mata.

records.preserveReason: Fluorapatite is the proper mineral specimen name used by the game's museum collection.

records.source: Small amounts are found in human teeth.
records.translation: Matatagpuan ang maliit na dami nito sa mga ngipin ng tao.

records.source: Plays a flute sound when you walk past.
records.translation: Tumutunog na parang plawta kapag nilagpasan mo.

records.source: A thick and sturdy leg bone.
records.translation: Makapal at matibay na buto ng binti.

records.source: Long ago, these ribs protected the body of a large animal.
records.translation: Noong unang panahon, pinrotektahan ng mga tadyang na ito ang katawan ng malaking hayop.
